summary: Complete testing of three P0 features: Today's Schedule, New Appointment dialog, and Manage Shop page (Barber/Service CRUD). All 26 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend features tested successfully via Playwright.

minor.issue: Timezone handling requires explicit UTC offset in scheduled_at (e.g., +00:00) - otherwise times outside business hours may be rejected unexpectedly

issues: Console warning about chart width/height -1 at initial render - cosmetic only, chart renders correctly after data loads

critical_code_review_comments: All three P0 features are well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Barber/Service delete is a soft-delete (sets active=false) - good practice for data integrity
Today's Schedule properly enriches appointments with client, barber, service details via N+1 queries - acceptable for dashboard but could be optimized with aggregation if performance is a concern
New Appointment modal validates required fields before submission
Console warning about chart dimensions is benign - Recharts renders correctly after data loads

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three P0 features are fully functional: 1) Dashboard 'Today's Schedule' shows appointments with time, client name, service, barber, status badge. 2) 'New Appointment' button on /appointments opens modal with all required fields (client search/select, barber dropdown, service dropdown, date picker, time picker, notes textarea) and calls POST /api/appointments. 3) Manage Shop page at /manage has tabs for Barbers and Services with full CRUD (add/edit/delete). Business hours are Mon-Fri 9-18, Thu-Fri 9-20, Sat 8-17, Sunday closed. Shop timezone is America/New_York.
